ideas.pitch: An automated OSINT investigation workspace that aggregates public metadata, social media footprints, and geolocation data to reconstruct digital trails during CTF challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence): Track down hidden information and piece together digital trails across the public internet.
ideas.title: OSINT-Trailblazer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a high-friction category in CTFs where manual searching is slow; automating multi-source data correlation gives teams a competitive speed advantage on the leaderboard.

ideas.pitch: An interactive cryptographic analysis and automated cipher-breaking suite designed to quickly identify encoding types, frequency analysis anomalies, and weak RSA/AES implementations.
ideas.problem_statement: Cryptography: Break encryption schemes, decode ciphers, and analyze cryptographic protocols.
ideas.title: CipherForge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous mathematical automation with a clean UI, solving the exact cipher-guessing bottlenecks players face in jeopardy CTFs.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web vulnerability scanner and sandbox environment built specifically for rapidly detecting and exploiting SQLi, XSS, IDOR, and SSRF flaws during live CTF matches.
ideas.problem_statement: Web Exploitation: Uncover vulnerabilities in web applications (e.g., SQLi, XSS, IDOR, SSRF).
ideas.title: PayloadLab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the most common point-scoring category in jeopardy CTFs by providing an integrated toolkit instead of relying on disjointed command-line scripts.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined digital forensics triage tool for fast parsing of memory dumps and PCAP files, extracting hidden strings, IOCs, and suspicious network streams.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital Forensics: Analyze memory dumps, network packet captures (PCAPs), and hidden file metadata.
ideas.title: MemoryScope
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the tedious file-carving and packet-inspection challenges of forensics tracks by providing instant visual timelines and automated artifact extraction.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent static binary analysis wrapper that correlates assembly patterns with known vulnerable code snippets to speed up reverse engineering challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Reverse Engineering: Deconstruct compiled binaries and understand their underlying logic.
ideas.title: BinaryDeconstruct
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a force multiplier for analyzing stripped binaries under strict time limits, standing out through practical automation for reverse engineering enthusiasts.
